objective: Issue #51, web only: the tutor panel stops showing text about a position that is gone (FR-24). When the player makes a move, everything the panel showed leaves it at once (on move_attempted, the optimistic move): the question, its reveal, the try result, a tutor_failed message and a refused-Hint/Show-me notice. Late tutor_attempt / tutor_reveal events for the question that was just left (they arrive after the move that was the try) must not bring it back into the panel. The panel shows a question again only from the server: a takeback whose GameView.tutor.question is open (FR-8 retry) shows it as now, and a new tutor_reply shows the new one. A move the server rejects (move_rejected, request_failed) restores the panel exactly as it was before the attempt. Do NOT build the try-result pop-up (that is #52, next) or the move-list notes (#54); the try result simply stops appearing in the panel for now.
contract:
Issue #51 Done when: (1) when you make a move, everything the panel showed leaves it: the question, its answer, the try result, a failure message (FR-24); (2) a takeback that brings back a question that's still open shows it again, as now (FR-8); (3) tests pass in CI.
FR-24 (docs/requirements.md, A6 2026-11-15): 'The tutor panel only shows text about the position on the board. When the player makes a move, whatever the panel showed leaves it. When the engine grades the player's attempt (FR-8), the result appears as a short notice near the board that closes after about 5 seconds or at the player's next move' — the notice part is #52, not this round.
Cause (found by the owner in the deployed app): apps/web/src/game-state.ts TutorPanelState keeps 'the last question (still shown after it closes)'; the server already closes the question when the player moves on, and after #47 keeps a shown (revealed) question in GameView.tutor.question only until the next player move, a takeback, a new ask or game end.
Reducer facts at base 1e382ac (apps/web/src/game-state.ts): move_attempted sets pendingFen/busy; move_accepted applies the reply via applyReplyGame/syncTutor; tutorEvent handles tutor_thinking/progress/reply/failed/reveal/attempt; tutor_attempt is ignored when tutor.question.id differs; applyReveal ignores a reveal for another question. Keep the tutor thinking/progress state as is on a move (the tutor may be working on the bot's last move; the server decides).
api.ts at 1e382ac now also has optional GameView.notes: TutorNote[] (#53, server side, in flight). Ignore it this round; #54 will display it.
